name: Joint Interagency Task Force–South (JIATF-South)
detail: SOUTHCOM's intelligence fusion cell coordinating detection, monitoring and interdiction targeting data across coalition member navies, coast guards and law enforcement — the operational nerve center feeding Southern Spear strike decisions.

name: SOUTHCOM Headquarters, Doral FL
detail: US Southern Command headquarters and coalition secretariat; hosted the 5 March Joint Security Declaration signing and serves as the coalition's de facto command hub.

name: Doral Charter
detail: Founding instrument signed by 17 nations on 7 March 2026 committing signatories to democratic governance, free-market principles, deeper trade cooperation, and coordinated action against organized crime.

name: A3C Panama Ministerial Forum
detail: Second Americas Counter Cartel Coalition ministerial, held 12 August 2026 in Panama; Hegseth addressed defense ministers/chiefs from 18 partner nations on operationalizing coalition strategy.

name: PANAMAX 2026
detail: SOUTHCOM's premier multinational exercise for collective defense of the Panama Canal; ran alongside the August A3C forum with Secretary Hegseth participating.

name: US Space Force TacSRT
detail: Tactical Surveillance, Reconnaissance and Tracking satellite support made available to coalition members for maritime domain awareness against trafficking routes.

name: Operation Southern Spear
detail: Ongoing US kinetic strike campaign against suspected drug-trafficking vessels in the Caribbean and eastern Pacific — more than 50 strikes and at least 190 killed since September 2025 — that functions as the coalition's operational spearhead.

name: Colombia joint military operations request
detail: President De la Espriella formally requested joint US-Colombia military operations against narco-terrorist groups on Colombian soil, opening the door to on-the-ground coalition basing and overflight arrangements not yet finalized as of 20 Aug 2026.

name: Plan Colombia 2.0 security package
detail: $1 billion US security assistance pledge to Colombia announced by Trump following the Chocó earthquake and Colombia's accession, intended to fund equipment, training and joint operations infrastructure.

name: US-Chile critical minerals agreement
detail: Economic cooperation agreement signed by Trump and Chilean President José Antonio Kast at the founding summit, linking coalition security membership to critical-minerals trade access.

name: Medellín coordination hub (proposed)
detail: De la Espriella's proposal to base Colombia's coalition liaison and coordination functions in Medellín rather than Bogotá, part of a broader decentralization push; not yet formally established.

name: A3C campaign plan working groups
detail: Priority-network working groups stood up per SOUTHCOM commander Gen. Francis Donovan's direction to draft the coalition's first multinational campaign plan, targeted for approval by November 2026 — SCHEDULED, not yet complete.
